title: Model: fields, methods, constructors, and static initializers
objective: Represent declared members and code units with stable JVM signatures and ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Overloads and constructors have unambiguous identifiers.
Static initializers and compiler-created members remain representable.
Member ordering is independent of class-file encounter order.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
Do not add dependencies or change Maven configuration.
